svg.title: Under the hood of Hephaestus
svg.desc: You drive Hephaestus from heph, the CLI, or a console. Every request goes to hephaestusd, the only program allowed to write the record. It runs the old and new versions in the Arena, each in its own sandbox; a sealed judge scores both and sends back signed scores; the daemon writes them to the Ledger; and replaying the Ledger must reproduce the live state exactly.
